primaryEvidence.qualification: MEHAT approved-urban-plan table has Commune=Smar and Zone=bni Mhira, approval publication29Dec2023. This establishes a named urban planning locality; commune is not delegation and cannot override Beni Mhira administrative membership.

Social Affairs identifies its local office at the Beni Mhira delegation seat and publishes an institution point near the western/new-school context. The point identifies the office, not a town boundary, OSM point equality, or INM calculation anchor.

The ministry announces approval of planning documents for Remada municipality and the Bir Thlathin and Beni Mhira zones. This independently supports a named Beni Mhira urban locality; the announcement does not bind either candidate coordinate to a town footprint.
